rationale: The agent did authenticate the user correctly and performed a modification to the user's order without any errors in those steps. However, the agent failed the customer's request by not being able to refund the modification to the gift card as requested. Instead, the agent stated that the refund would only go back to the original payment method (credit card) which was not what the customer desired. This indicates a failure in fulfilling the user's request in accordance with the policy regarding refunds.
